generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the cane base: it gives the values the cane program gave as defaults until then. Homed at the genus, as the library has no rank for the bamboos' subfamily yet.

traits.life_span.note: Galloway (p. 26-27): the Phyllostachys bamboos live for many years, each clump sending new culms up every season from rhizomes running back to older mother plants.

traits.clonal.note: Galloway (p. 26-27): young plants of a Phyllostachys clump come up at its edges on rhizomes from older mother plants; he counts them among the creeping bamboos, unlike the clump bamboos.

traits.woodiness.note: Hitchcock (p. 16 and the Bambuseae, p. 29-31): the culms of bamboos are woody.

generator.params.cane_length.why: A grove's canes each reach their full length in the weeks after they rise, and the most vigorous the most the flora gives, so a cane's length is its culms' greatest usual length.

generator.params.cane_radius.why: A cane is thickest at its foot, as thick as the stoutest culms the flora measures.
